hints.text: Both nums1 and nums2 are sorted in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Two Index Comparison
hints.text: Compare elements at the current indices of nums1 and nums2.

hints.title: Index Advance Rule
hints.text: Advance the index pointing to the smaller element until a match is found or an array is exhausted.

hints.title: Two Pointer Common Search Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan with two pointers across sorted arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs takes O(n * m) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses two pointers to find the smallest common element in linear time and constant space.
